mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, signaling a contraction in manufacturing activity, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and UNRATE rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (proxied by PAYEMS) grow by less than 100,000 per month for two consecutive months, signaling a weakening labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 100k for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year for three consecutive months, signaling an entrenched inflationary environment, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (proxied by RSAFS) decline year-over-year while the federal funds rate is rising, it signals a credit crunch that will pressure economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY decline and FEDFUNDS rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.
